makeLuaSprite.description: Creates a Lua Sprite with a specific image and stores it with the given tag name.

parameters.image: Image path from 'images/' folder (ex. 'funkay', 'myStage/myImage'). Use null for no image.
parameters.x: X position on screen. Defaults to 0.
parameters.y: Y position on screen. Defaults to 0.

examples: Creates a sprite with the 'funkay' image.

makeAnimatedLuaSprite.description: Creates an animated Lua Sprite with image and .XML/.JSON/.TXT animation data.

parameters.image: Image path with animation data files (ex. 'logoBumpin' loads logoBumpin.png/.xml).
parameters.x: X position on screen. Defaults to 0.
parameters.y: Y position on screen. Defaults to 0.

makeGraphic.description: Generates a solid color square as graphic for a Lua Sprite.

parameters.color: Hex color or color name (ex. 'FF0000', 'red'). Defaults to 'FFFFFF' (white).

loadGraphic.description: Loads an image to a Lua Sprite with optional grid for frame division.

parameters.gridX: Frame width for grid division. Defaults to 0 (no grid).
parameters.gridY: Frame height for grid division. Defaults to 0 (no grid).

examples: Loads the 'funkay' image to the sprite.
Loads image with 150x150 frame grid for sprite sheet.

loadFrames.description: Loads a specific image and .XML/.JSON/.TXT animation data to a Lua Sprite.

parameters.image: Image path (loads image.png and image.xml/json automatically).

examples: Loads logoBumpin.png with logoBumpin.xml animation data.

addAnimation.description: Adds an animation to a Lua Sprite from loaded frames.

parameters.name: Animation name identifier.
parameters.frames: Frame indices as string ("0,1,2") or array ({0,1,2,3}).
parameters.framerate: Animation speed in frames per second. Defaults to 24.
parameters.loop: Whether animation repeats. Defaults to false.

examples: Adds looping 'idle' at 12 fps with frames 0-3.

addAnimationByPrefix.description: Adds an animation using frame prefix matching (matches frames starting with prefix).

parameters.name: Animation name identifier.
parameters.prefix: Prefix to match frames (ex. 'character-idle' matches 'character-idle0', 'character-idle1', etc).
parameters.framerate: Animation speed in FPS. Defaults to 24.
parameters.loop: Whether animation repeats. Defaults to false.

examples: Adds animation matching frames starting with 'character-idle'.

playAnim.description: Plays an animation on a Lua Sprite.

parameters.name: Animation name to play.
parameters.force: Force restart even if already playing. Defaults to false.
parameters.reverse: Play animation backwards. Defaults to false.
parameters.startFrame: Start at specific frame. Defaults to 0.

addLuaSprite.description: Adds a Lua Sprite to the scene. By default adds it behind the stage.

parameters.inFront: If true, adds in front of stage. If false, adds behind. Defaults to false.

examples: Adds sprite in front of the stage.

removeLuaSprite.description: Removes a Lua Sprite from the scene.

parameters.destroy: Whether to destroy the sprite entirely. Defaults to true.

luaSpriteExists.description: Returns whether a Lua Sprite with the given tag exists.

parameters.tag: Lua Sprite tag name to check.
